constraints.name: accepted_versions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (version_no = 1 AND parent_version_no IS NULL AND origin_submission_id IS NULL OR version_no > 1 AND parent_version_no IS NOT NULL AND parent_version_no = (version_no - 1) AND origin_submission_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: accepted_versions_diameter_cm_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (diameter_cm IS NULL OR diameter_cm >= 0::numeric AND diameter_cm <= 999999.99 AND diameter_cm = trunc(diameter_cm, 2))

constraints.name: accepted_versions_record_id_parent_version_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (record_id, parent_version_no) REFERENCES fieldmerge.accepted_versions(record_id, version_no)

constraints.name: accepted_versions_species_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (species IS NULL OR fieldmerge.valid_scalar('species'::text, to_jsonb(species)))

constraints.name: version_origin_same_record
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (origin_submission_id, record_id) REFERENCES fieldmerge.submissions(submission_id, record_id)

constraints.name: field_changes_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (fieldmerge.valid_scalar(field_name, base_value) AND fieldmerge.valid_scalar(field_name, proposed_value) AND fieldmerge.valid_scalar(field_name, compared_value))

constraints.name: field_changes_record_id_applied_version_no_fkey

constraints.name: field_changes_record_id_compared_version_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (record_id, compared_version_no) REFERENCES fieldmerge.accepted_versions(record_id, version_no)

constraints.name: field_changes_submission_id_record_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id, record_id) REFERENCES fieldmerge.submissions(submission_id, record_id)

constraints.name: review_decisions_change_id_record_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (change_id, record_id) REFERENCES fieldmerge.field_changes(change_id, record_id)

constraints.name: review_decisions_record_id_expected_version_no_fkey

constraints.name: review_decisions_record_id_result_version_no_fkey

constraints.name: submissions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['awaiting_document'::text, 'rejected'::text])) OR source_verified_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: submissions_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (state <> 'rejected'::text OR length(btrim(rejection_reason)) > 0 AND rejection_reason IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: submissions_record_id_base_version_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (record_id, base_version_no) REFERENCES fieldmerge.accepted_versions(record_id, version_no)

constraints.name: recovery_jobs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (job_kind <> 'submission'::text OR submission_id IS NOT NULL AND submission_id = target_id)

views.name: field_value_provenance
views.definition:
WITH values_at_version AS (
         SELECT v.record_id,
            v.version_no,
            v.origin_submission_id,
            v.published_by,
            v.created_at,
            f_1.field_name,
            COALESCE((to_jsonb(v.*) -> f_1.field_name), 'null'::jsonb) AS value,
            COALESCE((to_jsonb(prev.*) -> f_1.field_name), 'null'::jsonb) AS previous_value
           FROM ((fieldmerge.accepted_versions v
             LEFT JOIN fieldmerge.accepted_versions prev ON (((prev.record_id = v.record_id) AND (prev.version_no = v.parent_version_no))))
             CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('species'::text), ('health'::text), ('diameter_cm'::text), ('guard_damage'::text)) f_1(field_name))
        ), actual_changes AS (
         SELECT values_at_version.record_id,
            values_at_version.version_no,
            values_at_version.origin_submission_id,
            values_at_version.published_by,
            values_at_version.created_at,
            values_at_version.field_name,
            values_at_version.value,
            values_at_version.previous_value
           FROM values_at_version
          WHERE ((values_at_version.version_no = 1) OR (values_at_version.value IS DISTINCT FROM values_at_version.previous_value))
        )
 SELECT target.record_id,
    target.version_no,
    f.field_name,
    origin.version_no AS origin_version_no,
    origin.value,
    origin.published_by,
    origin.created_at,
    origin.origin_submission_id,
    c.change_id,
    d.decision_id,
    d.reviewer_id,
    d.reason
   FROM ((((fieldmerge.accepted_versions target
     CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('species'::text), ('health'::text), ('diameter_cm'::text), ('guard_damage'::text)) f(field_name))
     JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.record_id,
            a.version_no,
            a.origin_submission_id,
            a.published_by,
            a.created_at,
            a.field_name,
            a.value,
            a.previous_value
           FROM actual_changes a
          WHERE ((a.record_id = target.record_id) AND (a.field_name = f.field_name) AND (a.version_no <= target.version_no))
          ORDER BY a.version_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) origin ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN fieldmerge.field_changes c ON (((c.record_id = origin.record_id) AND (c.applied_version_no = origin.version_no) AND (c.field_name = f.field_name))))
     LEFT JOIN fieldmerge.review_decisions d ON ((d.change_id = c.change_id)));

views.name: latest_accepted_records
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.record_id) r.campaign_id,
    r.source_record_id,
    r.is_active,
    v.record_id,
    v.version_no,
    v.parent_version_no,
    v.species,
    v.health,
    v.diameter_cm,
    v.guard_damage,
    v.origin_submission_id,
    v.published_by,
    v.created_at
   FROM (fieldmerge.accepted_versions v
     JOIN fieldmerge.tree_records r USING (record_id))
  ORDER BY v.record_id, v.version_no DESC;

views.name: pending_field_reviews
views.definition:
SELECT c.change_id,
    c.submission_id,
    c.record_id,
    c.field_name,
    c.base_value,
    c.proposed_value,
    c.compared_value,
    c.compared_version_no,
    c.classification,
    c.state,
    c.pending_reason,
    c.revision_no,
    c.applied_version_no,
    c.updated_at,
    s.author_id,
    s.observed_at,
    s.received_at,
    v.version_no AS current_version_no,
        CASE c.field_name
            WHEN 'species'::text THEN COALESCE(to_jsonb(v.species), 'null'::jsonb)
            WHEN 'health'::text THEN COALESCE(to_jsonb(v.health), 'null'::jsonb)
            WHEN 'diameter_cm'::text THEN COALESCE(to_jsonb(v.diameter_cm), 'null'::jsonb)
            ELSE COALESCE(to_jsonb(v.guard_damage), 'null'::jsonb)
        END AS current_value
   FROM ((fieldmerge.field_changes c
     JOIN fieldmerge.submissions s USING (submission_id))
     JOIN fieldmerge.latest_accepted_records v ON ((v.record_id = c.record_id)))
  WHERE (c.state = 'pending'::text);

views.name: submission_outcomes
views.definition:
SELECT s.submission_id,
    s.author_id,
    s.record_id,
    s.state,
    count(c.change_id) AS proposed_fields,
    count(c.change_id) FILTER (WHERE (c.state = 'pending'::text)) AS pending_fields,
    count(c.change_id) FILTER (WHERE (c.state = 'applied'::text)) AS applied_fields
   FROM (fieldmerge.submissions s
     LEFT JOIN fieldmerge.field_changes c USING (submission_id))
  GROUP BY s.submission_id;
